module NonResultValueEnsures

type Point is record
    x: Integer
    y: Integer
end record

function increment(amount: Integer) returns Integer
ensures value = amount + 1
is
    return amount + 1
end increment

function make_point(x: Integer, y: Integer) returns Point
ensures value.x = x
ensures value.y = y
is
    return Point { x: x, y: y }
end make_point

function make_pair(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Array<Integer, 2>
ensures value[0] = a
ensures value[1] = b
is
    return [a, b]
end make_pair

end NonResultValueEnsures
